metadata.rag_tier_description: Complete evidence + distractors (GROUND_TRUTH_FILE) — comprehension + relevance filtering + synthesis.
metadata.system_text: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's message directly in plain text.
metadata.sampling_note: temperature / top_p / top_k are not controllable through `claude -p`; CLI defaults apply
metadata.claude_code_call: claude -p --model <id> --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages --tools '' --max-turns 1 [--system-prompt <neutral text>]; cwd = empty temp dir; output cap via CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS; raw events in <cell dir>/raw_calls
metadata.response_text_policy: Generated_Response is the model text as returned; never altered
metadata.year_resolution: release year resolved from GROUND_TRUTH_FILE by S.No (source file has no year column)
metadata.population_handling: GT values parsed with float() first; model answers with unit-aware parser
metadata.latent_note: Claude Code returns no per-token data; latent fields are zeros

rag_tiers_available.no_evidence: No evidence — knowledge retrieval / reasoning from parametric memory.
rag_tiers_available.year_list_only: Co-year title list only (REFERENCE_FILE) — candidate identification + knowledge retrieval.
rag_tiers_available.titles_authors: Titles + directors (REFERENCE_FILE) — entity linking + further knowledge retrieval.
rag_tiers_available.titles_authors_prize: Titles + directors + award (REFERENCE_FILE) — filtering + further retrieval.
rag_tiers_available.full_with_birthplace: Candidate directors + birthplace, no population (GROUND_TRUTH_FILE) — multi-hop comprehension + population retrieval.
rag_tiers_available.full_with_population: Complete evidence including population (GROUND_TRUTH_FILE) — reading comprehension + multi-hop synthesis.
rag_tiers_available.full_with_distractors: Complete evidence + distractors (GROUND_TRUTH_FILE) — comprehension + relevance filtering + synthesis.
